segments.text: Versell open-sourced an agent framework that structures your AI assistance exactly like directories of files. Eve
organizes your entire agent stack into a single folder, mapping markdown for instructions and TypeScript for custom tools. It features sandboxed compute and
durable sessions that survive crashes and redeploys. You can spin up an agent locally, then deploy your files straight
